title: Datadog Application key (ddapp_-prefixed): one-property twin (prefix) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: one prefix byte changed (ddaqp_, not a Datadog prefix); body unchanged and the documented lower-case ddapp_ prefix written in upper case (DDAPP_); body unchanged. Twin of "Datadog Application key (ddapp_-prefixed): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of datadog-application-key-api-client-python: one prefix byte changed (ddaqp_, not a Datadog prefix); body unchanged. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
